newsitem.title: UK: Euro cotton market sees enquiry as New York firms.
newsitem.headline: Euro cotton market sees enquiry as New York firms.

text.p: New York's firmness hit trade willingness to discount raw cotton prices and prompted price-testing enquiry by mill buyers, industry sources said.

But the trade pattern in western Europe was little changed. New business consisted mainly of central Asian and Greek descriptions to fill requirements up to the end of the year. In addition, Portuguese buyers also showed interest in Spanish new crop and modest quantities changed hands.
Similar business was done in France, where sector conditions seemed to have improved, they added. Overall, the market was watching Mediterranean and central Asian weather developments.
